title: Domestic Flights Promo/Voucher (Emergency)
body:
Hi all,
We have a sudden family emergency and need to book domestic return flights from Sydney to Melbourne for 6 people this coming Saturday or Sunday.
I’ve bought Jetstar vouchers from members in this community before.
Does anyone know where I can find—or have available—any Jetstar, Virgin, or Qantas vouchers or active promo codes?
Please PM me directly if you can help out.
Thanks so much, everyone
